supportLevel: Unofficial public Microsoft Fabric status mirror based on HTML scraping

active.detailsHtml: Fabric customers in the East US region may experience intermittent latency or timeouts when using Notebooks, Lakehouse, or Pipelines due to an Azure Storage service issue. Azure Storage engineers are actively investigating the issue. The next update will be provided by October 28, 2026, at 1:30 AM UTC.
